title: meibomia cuneata
intro: Meibomia cuneata, commonly known as Butterfly Weed, is a plant species belonging to the Apocynaceae family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. Its therapeutic actions include serving as an expectorant to help loosen and clear mucus from the airways, and as an anti-inflammatory to reduce swelling and pain. The bioactive constituents of Butterfly Weed include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
